faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find clear, reassuring answers to common questions about appointments, comfort, and care.

items.question: How often should my family visit for a routine dental checkup?
items.answer: We recommend a routine examination and professional cleaning every 6 months for most children and adults. Regular visits catch minor issues before they become painful or costly.

items.question: What if I experience extreme dental anxiety or fear?
items.answer: You are not alone. We specialize in anxious patients. We take things at your pace, use gentle numbing techniques, explain everything beforehand, and give you full control with a simple hand-signal stop system.

items.question: At what age should a child first see the dentist?
items.answer: We recommend bringing your child when their first tooth appears, or by their first birthday. These early visits help children get comfortable in the dental chair and prevent early tooth decay.

items.question: Do clear aligners work as well as traditional braces?
items.answer: Yes, for the vast majority of mild to moderate alignment cases, modern clear aligners are just as effective as traditional metal braces, while being practically invisible and easily removable for meals.

items.question: What should I do in a dental emergency?
items.answer: Call our clinic immediately. We reserve daily emergency slots for severe toothache, chipped teeth, lost fillings, or dental trauma to provide same-day pain relief.

items.question: Are your dental instruments sterilized for every appointment?
items.answer: Yes, without exception. We follow strict hospital-grade sterilization protocols. Every instrument goes through ultrasonic cleaning and autoclave heat sterilization in sealed pouches opened in front of you.
